title: Influence of Reaction Conditions and Promoting Role of Ammonia Produced at Higher Temperature Conditions in Its Synthesis Process over Cs-Ru/MgO Catalyst
extraction_notes: The SI contains experimental-method conditions for Cs–Ru/MgO catalyst on SI page 2, but no tabulated or text-printed NH3 synthesis rate/outlet NH3/TOF values. SI Figure S1 (page 3) reports STY surfaces for NH3 synthesis versus H2/N2 ratio, pressure, temperature, and SV, but the 3D surface plots are too dense/occluded to tie individual readable numerical STY values unambiguously to distinct conditions, so no figure-read records were extracted. SI Figures S2 and S3 (pages 5 and 7, with image content on pages 4–7) are rate-equation application plots with transformed variables rather than direct NH3 synthesis performance metrics, so they were not extracted.
